overview.description: The Invesco Taxable Municipal Bond ETF (BAB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a broad index of taxable investment-grade municipal debts selected and weighted by market value. BAB was launched on Nov 17, 2009 and is issued by Invesco.
